story.title: The Obituary of Tomorrow
story.logline: A man receives tomorrow's newspaper on his doorstep today and reads his own obituary, forcing him to race against a fatal deadline.
story.twist: The obituary was not predicting his death, but detailing the exact moment he murders the delivery boy.
story.ending: Are we dodging our fate, or are we the ones building it?

scenes.narration: My obituary arrived today, printed neatly in tomorrow's morning newspaper, detailing my sudden and very violent end.
scenes.visual_prompt: A 28-year-old man with messy brown hair and a grey hoodie standing on a dim suburban porch holding a newspaper.
scenes.camera: Extreme close-up on the bold newspaper headline, rapid push-in.

scenes.narration: I checked the date twice. October twelfth. Today is the eleventh. The ink was still wet against my trembling fingers.
scenes.visual_prompt: A 28-year-old man with messy brown hair and a grey hoodie squinting at the date printed on the front page.

scenes.narration: It said I would die at midnight in the alley behind my apartment building, stabbed by a desperate stranger.
scenes.visual_prompt: A 28-year-old man with messy brown hair and a grey hoodie staring wide-eyed at the printed text.

scenes.narration: I decided to cheat destiny. I locked all my doors, pulled down the heavy metal blinds, and refused to leave.
scenes.visual_prompt: A 28-year-old man with messy brown hair and a grey hoodie locking a heavy deadbolt on a dark apartment door.

scenes.narration: Hours bled past in absolute silence. The clock on the wall crept closer to midnight with agonizing slowness.
scenes.visual_prompt: A 28-year-old man with messy brown hair and a grey hoodie watching a digital wall clock glow 11:50.
scenes.camera: Static wide shot of the dark living room.

scenes.narration: Then, a frantic knocking echoed from my front door. Someone was screaming for help in the dark corridor.
scenes.visual_prompt: A 28-year-old man with messy brown hair and a grey hoodie flinching as heavy bangs hit the apartment door.

scenes.narration: I grabbed a heavy kitchen knife and flung the door open, ready to fight whatever horror waited outside.
scenes.visual_prompt: A 28-year-old man with messy brown hair and a grey hoodie gripping a shiny kitchen knife while swinging the door open.
scenes.camera: POV shot looking out into the dim hallway.

scenes.narration: A terrified teenage delivery boy stumbled backward into my hallway, begging me to hide him from an attacker.
scenes.visual_prompt: A 28-year-old man with messy brown hair and a grey hoodie towering over a panicked kid in a blue jacket.

scenes.narration: In my blind panic, I lunged forward with the blade, not realizing my own terrifying role in the prophecy.
scenes.visual_prompt: A 28-year-old man with messy brown hair and a grey hoodie accidentally striking forward in the shadows.
scenes.camera: Close-up on hands and the weapon.

scenes.narration: As he fell, I read the headline again and realized the tragic truth. Are we dodging fate, or building it?
scenes.visual_prompt: A 28-year-old man with messy brown hair and a grey hoodie staring in horror at his bloodstained hands.
scenes.camera: High angle overhead shot zooming out slowly.

caption.hook: Today's newspaper just printed my murder.
caption.title: The Obituary of Tomorrow
caption.caption:
I stared at my own death date in the morning paper, racing to rewrite a future I was already living. But destiny isn't a prediction; it's a trap we set ourselves.

How far would you go to cheat your fate?
